program: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) federal individual monthly payment rule
formula_text: Payment = max(943 - max(U - 20, 0) - (1/2) * max(E - 65 - max(20 - U, 0), 0), 0) dollars per month.
anomalies: The network uses a $943 monthly federal benefit rate, which is stale and disagrees with the 2026 current-law rate of $994; this can underpay benefits by as much as $51 per month.
